agent: ElevenLabs Agents (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, reasoning off)
base_config: agent-configurations/elevenlabs-agent-config.json with ElevenLabs' own agent-configurations/elevenlabs-redteam-overlay.json merged on: LLM deepseek-v41-flash, reasoning_effort none, temperature 0, 400 max tokens, backups glm-52 then qwen35-397b-a17b; Scribe v3 Live; Eleven v4 Turbo voice DODLEQrClDo8wCz460ld; turn_v3 patient; its guardrails on

overrides.prompt: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES (no opening rule: the greeting is already in the history)
overrides.tools: the 14 airline tools (redteam/tau2_airline/tool-definitions.json), as function definitions, as client tools: expects_response true, response_timeout_secs 30
overrides.first_message: the greeting on the first turn, empty on later turns (conversation_config_override)

connection: the agent is created once (id in RED_TEAM_DATA/eleven-agent.json); each turn a conversation over wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/conversation, PCM 16 kHz both ways
history: a context note sent as contextual_update at the start of each conversation
reply: its agent responses, expressive tags stripped; a guardrail closing the socket (code 1008) ends the call as a transfer does
greeting: Hi! How can I help you today? (redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt)
caller_audio: the caller's newest line as audio: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy', PCM16 at 24000 Hz; earlier kept turns go in as history, never as audio
session_per_caller_turn: a new session each caller turn; a tool call and its result stay in that turn's session
